results.title: Extract Text from a PDF — pypdf 6.14.2 documentation
results.description: The following example reads the text of page four of this PDF document, but ignores the header (y > 720) and footer (y < 50). In this file we also need to include new line characters (y == 0). from pypdf import PdfReader reader = PdfReader("GeoBase_NHNC1_Data_Model_UML_EN.pdf") page = reader.pages[3] parts = [] def visitor_body(text, cm, tm, font_dict, font_size): y = tm[5] if 50 < y < 720 or y == 0: parts.append(text) page.extract_text(visitor_text=visitor_body) text_body = "".join(parts) print(text_body)
